intro: A first resume without full-time experience that still shows reliability, initiative and skill, through part-time work, study and a project.
tips: Lead with your strongest section: often education or a project.
Treat part-time work seriously: reliability and customers are real skills.
Keep it to one full page.

basics.name: Jordan Lee
basics.label: Business Graduate
basics.summary: Business graduate with a major in marketing, three years of part-time retail work and a student project that tripled a club's membership. Looking for a graduate role in marketing or operations.

work.name: Kiwi Coffee Co.
highlights: Trusted to open and close and to run shifts of four staff.
Trained six new baristas; introduced a checklist that cut morning set-up time by 15 minutes.

work.name: University of Auckland Marketing Club
highlights: Planned 12 events a year, including a careers night with 8 employers and 150 students.
Ran the club's Instagram; membership grew from 60 to 190.

projects.name: Café loyalty study
highlights: Surveyed 220 customers of a local café and designed a loyalty card the owner adopted; repeat visits rose 18% in three months.
